[[File:Sonar Bobber In-game.png|thumb|120px|right|Fish being caught is displayed on the top-right of the fishing mini-game]]
The '''Sonar Bobber''' is a [[tackle]] that helps [[fishing]] by showing what fish is on the line before it is caught. The fish being hooked is revealed right outside of the mini-game display on the top-right.

It can be [[Crafting|crafted]], purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|500}} after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 6]], or randomly found in regular [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] (3-4% chance) after reaching Fishing level 6 and in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (9-10% chance).<ref name="chestchance" />

Note that using two Sonar Bobbers on an [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] provides no additional benefit as opposed to only using one.

The Sonar Bobber is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Sonar Bobber is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used as a gray [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
The Sonar Bobber is not used in any [[quests]].
